acceptance.basis: Unchanged engineering completeness/coverage/ATE/RPE limits from the previous plane study. Fixed before first image-tracking/PnP fitting; not publisher accuracy requirements or physical calibration guarantees.

calibration.axes: x right, y down, z forward
calibration.basis: Publisher recommends ROS default intrinsics without undistortion for pre-registered PNG depth. Depth is already rescaled and expressed in RGB optical coordinates; apply no extra correction or IR-to-RGB transform. This is the recommended approximation, not newly measured calibration.

dense_fitting_preprocessing.depth_missing: original raw depth validity; no neighborhood expansion

dense_support_policy: Minimum count and a nonsingular system for initial/intermediate hypotheses; the unchanged 0.5 full-resolution correspondence fraction applies to the returned pose. The independent full-cloud support and complete trajectory accuracy gates are unchanged.
generation: All original adjacent RGB-D frames; identical Gaussian3 gray inputs, original unsmoothed metric depth and the prior returned relative seed, starting identity. Original raw final statistics and full-cloud/world/IO admission remain. No reference read, rescale, retries, selection or lost-chain reset.
native_refinement_policy: Only full-resolution fitting depth changes from the joint Gaussian3 control: copy original valid depth, keeping missing pixels at their original locations. Gray kernel, border, pyramid, derivatives, weight, iterations, stopping and all raw final/trajectory gates remain fixed. Charge the same retained raw planes.
scope: Prospective component comparison on two observed development scenes after preserving joint Gaussian3 xyz success and rpy loss at index 349. Preserve raw, joint and external controls and every failure; freeze both complete timelines before either new score. No post-score tuning, held-out, speed or physical-calibration claim.
